results.title: magpie: AI visual library for everything you save
results.content:
magpie is a visual library app that brings everything you save into one place. Its own summary is direct: everything you've saved, in one visual library. Rather than leaving references scattered across apps, magpie gathers your saves from Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Cosmos, Are.na, GitHub and your browser's bookmarks, and presents them as a single browsable collection of images, video saves and links. Each save is tagged by AI, so the library can be searched by what is actually in it, or by colour, rather than by the caption someone wrote or the account that posted it. The stated purpose is simple: give people who collect visual references a permanent, searchable home for them. It is built for anyone who saves things they intend to use later — designers, art directors, [...] •Multi-platform saves: magpie gathers what you save from Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Cosmos, Are.na, GitHub and your browser's bookmarks, bringing them into one visual library instead of leaving them spread across apps. The site also notes browser support for Chrome, Safari and Firefox, so saves arrive from the places you already browse.
 •AI tagging: every save is tagged by AI so it can be found by what is actually in it. That means a search can match the content of an image rather than depending on the caption attached to the original post, which is what makes a mixed library of saved pictures searchable at all. [...] you need it. magpie's answer is to keep everything you have saved, even when the post is gone, and to make the whole collection findable from one place instead of five. Capture is built around the places you already save from. The product lists Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Cosmos, Are.na, GitHub and your browser's bookmarks as sources, and its browser support covers Chrome, Safari and Firefox. The site also describes being able to paste a link anywhere, so a reference can be added without first navigating back to the app. Everything you save lands in the same library. # magpie

# Everything you save, in one library

Productivity • Design Resources • Chrome Extension

You save things everywhere: posts on Instagram, pins, tweets, videos, pages. magpie brings them into one visual library, keeps a real copy of each, and has AI tag and describe them, so you can find anything by what's in it, by colour, or by asking. Projects fill themselves with saves that fit.

The browser extension syncs what you've already saved on Instagram, X, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Are.na and more, and saves any page in one click. Free for 500 saves. Private: no feed, no ads, and your saves aren't used to train AI.
